name: Karina
source:
A member of the Ivan Empire’s Eastern Expeditionary Army.
The multi-legged T07-β she pilots may fall short of Mizuho’s machines in overall performance, yet its simplified design allows for heavier armour and far more efficient repairs.

Though young, she is a seasoned veteran who survived the war against the United Kingdom of Rimvon, with a remarkable ability to adapt to walking tanks. She is both capable and dependable, as well as a soldier of high calibre and a commander her subordinates can trust. On the other hand, she rarely opens her heart to others, which often makes her come across as condescending.

“Come now, show me what you’re made of!”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#calina]official website[/url]]
